status_detail: Laramie County public notice and July 8, 2026 county memo describe a Project Tembo data center site plan and CUP resubmittal, previously Project Jade by Crusoe. The memo says prior zone change and commercial site plan approvals were received and the project is being resubmitted by Google d.b.a. Jupiter Star Holdings. Local reporting says planning documents describe a 716-acre, four-data-hall campus with 2.7 GW and planned completion in 2031.
notes: Power hub/associated Tallgrass approvals and construction are related infrastructure; this line records the data center campus.

project_name: Related Digital Cheyenne Data Center Campus
status_detail: Related Digital announced an October 2025 groundbreaking for a $1.2B, 115-acre Cheyenne Business Parkway campus with up to 302 MW of critical IT capacity. The first 184,000 sq ft building on 36 acres is leased to CoreWeave for 88 MW and expected to complete in late 2026.
notes: Campus capacity recorded as 302 MW; first tenant/building capacity is 88 MW.

status_detail: Meta announced on July 2, 2024 that Cheyenne would host its newest data center, a 715,000-square-foot campus with more than $800M investment and about 100 jobs once complete. Later local/news references describe the campus as under construction and expected to open as early as 2027.
notes: Official Meta source gives square footage and investment but not MW; tracker sources split buildings at 109/87/40/40 MW, not used as primary capacity here.

status_detail: Microsoft announced on April 14, 2026 its intent to purchase about 3,200 acres to develop a datacenter in Cheyenne, building on its existing datacenter footprint. The expansion consists of about 200 acres in Bison Business Park and about 3,000 adjacent acres in southeast Cheyenne; Microsoft describes it as the start of a multiyear planning and development process requiring public hearings.
notes: Separate from Microsoft's existing Cheyenne operating footprint; capacity not disclosed in official announcement.

status_detail: Microsoft's local community page says Microsoft operates a datacenter in Cheyenne; the 2026 expansion announcement says the company has been operating in Cheyenne since its first datacenter development in 2012.
notes: Existing operating footprint; exact site count and MW not disclosed in the official sources reviewed.

status_detail: Cleanview lists a planned 624 MW Vantage Cheyenne Data Center on 1,800 acres in Laramie County. Local public references identify Vantage's proposed Laramie County project as Project Latigo, with community engagement before a future permit process.

developer: National Center for Atmospheric Research / UCAR
status_detail: NCAR/UCAR news says the $70M NCAR-Wyoming Supercomputing Center in Cheyenne's North Range Business Park was nearing full operation in 2012, with 153,000 square feet and a data storage/archive facility for scientific data. Cheyenne LEADS lists NWSC among local data center resources.
notes: HPC/scientific supercomputing and data archive facility; included because it is a substantial computing/data facility in Laramie County.

status_detail: CleanSpark announced it executed 75 MW of power contracts and completed acquisition of its first Wyoming bitcoin mining site on August 1, 2024; the first site had 30 MW of power capacity and was expected to add over 2 EH/s once operational. SEC purchase agreement exhibits identify MineOne properties at 635 Logistics Drive and Lot 1 Block 4 Venture Dr in Cheyenne, Laramie County.
notes: Crypto mining/digital infrastructure rather than conventional colocation; included under broad server/data center search criteria.
